Engines with twelve cylinders and cylinder deactivation, such as Lamborghini's Aventador V12, hold the exhaust valves of the shut-off cylinders closed with a switchable actuator; this code concerns that actuator's circuit on cylinder 11. While the circuit is faulty the module keeps all cylinders active, and if the valve gear is stuck in the off position the cylinder may misfire.

causes.label: Wiring shorted to ground
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance
Harness chafing through insulation

P3488.title: Cylinder 11 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit High
P3488.description: Cylinder 11 exhaust valve control voltage above expected range — short to power or open ground. Engines with twelve cylinders and cylinder deactivation, such as Lamborghini's Aventador V12, hold the exhaust valves of the shut-off cylinders closed with a switchable actuator; this code concerns that actuator's circuit on cylinder 11. While the circuit is faulty the module keeps all cylinders active, and if the valve gear is stuck in the off position the cylinder may misfire.

causes.label: Wiring shorted to battery
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance
Supply wire pinched against B+ source

P3489.title: Cylinder 12 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit/Open
P3489.description: P3489 reports that the circuit to the actuator for deactivation or the intake valve of cylinder 12, the highest cylinder number in this code series, is open. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; J2012 reserves the codes for cylinders 9 to 12 for engines with more than eight cylinders. Twelve-cylinder engines with shut-off span Mercedes' late-1990s V12, which deactivated every second cylinder in the firing order, Lamborghini's Aventador V12 that shuts down one cylinder bank below 135 km/h, and Bentley's W12. The Mercedes engine used a hydraulic solenoid pack, the kind of part such a circuit would drive; the bank-based systems publish no equivalent. Comparable logic on GM V8s calls a circuit open above 200 kohm with the output idle. P3491 and P3492 report shorts, P3490 a functional fault, P3493 the exhaust valve.

causes.label: Wire to the cylinder 12 actuator open or chafed
Cylinder 12 actuator coil open
Loose or corroded connector at cylinder 12
Output stage of the control module failed

symptoms: Engine no longer runs in reduced-cylinder mode
Somewhat higher fuel use on the highway

P3490.title: Cylinder 12 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Performance
P3490.description: P3490 concerns the mechanical result on cylinder 12: the actuator circuit passes its electrical checks, but the cylinder does not deactivate or reactivate as intended. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; J2012 reserves the codes for cylinders 9 to 12 for engines with more than eight cylinders. In a V12 up to six cylinders can be stopped, and on a valve-switching design the commanded state depends on oil pressure reaching the switching parts; Mercedes' M137 suffered exactly there, with failures of its solenoid pack and oil pressure tubes. Lamborghini's and Bentley's twelve-cylinder engines shut whole banks and publish no valve monitoring. NHTSA's GM lifter description explains what can stick: spring-loaded locking pins moved by oil. Electrical faults on cylinder 12: P3489, P3491, P3492.

causes.label: Oil pressure or quality inadequate to switch cylinder 12
Leak in the oil supply to the cylinder 12 actuator
Locking pins at cylinder 12 sticking
Actuator valve mechanically sluggish

P3491.title: Cylinder 12 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit Low
P3491.description: A ground fault on the control line of the cylinder 12 deactivation or intake valve actuator produces P3491. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; J2012 reserves the codes for cylinders 9 to 12 for engines with more than eight cylinders. The Aventador's cylinder deactivation system, introduced in 2012, shuts down one bank of six below 135 km/h, and Bentley's W12 drops one bank; neither publishes cylinder-level diagnostic codes. On GM V8s the corresponding low test watches for under 0.5 ohm to ground while the output is switched off, every 250 ms, and needs 20 hits in 25 samples. Because a grounded low-side line powers the actuator, the cylinder can be shut off against the module's will. P3489 (open) and P3492 (high) are the other circuit faults, P3495 the exhaust low.

causes.label: Cylinder 12 control wire shorted to ground
Internal short in the cylinder 12 actuator
Water ingress at the connector
Faulty control module driver

P3492.title: Cylinder 12 Deactivation/Intake Valve Control Circuit High
P3492.description: P3492 records a high condition on the control circuit of the cylinder 12 deactivation or intake valve actuator, generally a short to a supply voltage seen while the output is commanded on. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; J2012 reserves the codes for cylinders 9 to 12 for engines with more than eight cylinders. The Variable displacement overview notes that a V12 can stop up to six cylinders, and the production engines doing so (Mercedes M137, Lamborghini Aventador, Bentley W12) differ widely in method, from a hydraulic solenoid pack (M137) to bank shut-off with the valves left running (Bentley). Only a design with valve actuators has a cylinder 12 actuator to short. Expect deactivation to be inhibited and the engine to run on all twelve. P3489 and P3491 are the electrical siblings, P3496 the exhaust high code.

causes.label: Cylinder 12 control wire shorted to supply voltage
Shorted turns in the cylinder 12 actuator
Engine control module output damaged

symptoms: Engine runs permanently on twelve cylinders

P3493.title: Cylinder 12 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit/Open
P3493.description: P3493 applies to a separately controlled exhaust valve on cylinder 12 and reports that its actuator circuit is open. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; J2012 reserves the codes for cylinders 9 to 12 for engines with more than eight cylinders. Bentley's W12 and the Lamborghini Aventador V12 shut off banks; Bentley explicitly keeps the valves operating, and Lamborghini describes only the switch to six cylinders below 135 km/h. A GM patent treats the exhaust valves as a step of their own, stopping them before the intake valves, while GM's later production design drives both valves of a cylinder from one solenoid. An open exhaust circuit on cylinder 12 therefore points to a rare design. P3495 and P3496 are the short-circuit codes, P3494 the function, P3489 the intake side.

causes.label: Wire to the cylinder 12 exhaust actuator open
Coil of the cylinder 12 exhaust actuator interrupted
Exhaust actuator connector corroded
Control module output failed

P3494.title: Cylinder 12 Exhaust Valve Control Performance
P3494.description: P3494 is set when the exhaust valve of cylinder 12 does not follow its command although the actuator circuit is electrically intact. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; J2012 reserves the codes for cylinders 9 to 12 for engines with more than eight cylinders. Valve-based shut-off traps a charge in the cylinder; if the exhaust valve keeps opening, that cushion leaks away, which a Ford patent proposes to detect through exhaust pressure, and if it sticks shut on reactivation, compressed gas loads the valve train. The Aventador V12 and Bentley W12 sidestep this by bank shut-off without published valve switching, and for the Mercedes M137 with its hydraulic solenoid pack no public code assignment is known. Electrical faults of this actuator: P3493, P3495, P3496; intake function: P3490.

causes.label: Exhaust switching element at cylinder 12 sticking
Oil pressure or quality insufficient for the exhaust switch
Exhaust actuator sluggish

symptoms: Jolt or knock on reactivation of cylinder 12

P3495.title: Cylinder 12 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit Low
P3495.description: P3495 points to a low signal, usually a short to ground, on the control line of the cylinder 12 exhaust valve actuator. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; J2012 reserves the codes for cylinders 9 to 12 for engines with more than eight cylinders. The twelve-cylinder engines with deactivation (Bentley W12, Lamborghini Aventador V12, Mercedes M137) are not documented with a dedicated exhaust actuator per cylinder; the newer ones shut entire banks and keep the valves moving, as Bentley states for its W12. Where such an actuator does exist, the diagnosis follows the usual path: connector unplugged, resistance of the wire to ground, then the coil itself. P3493 is the open circuit, P3496 the short to voltage, and P3491 the low fault on the intake side of cylinder 12.

causes.label: Exhaust actuator wire of cylinder 12 grounded
Exhaust actuator with internal short
Control module output faulty

P3496.title: Cylinder 12 Exhaust Valve Control Circuit High
P3496.description: P3496 is the final code of the per-cylinder valve block: it marks the cylinder 12 exhaust valve control circuit as too high, typically a short to battery voltage or a coil with shorted turns. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; J2012 reserves the codes for cylinders 9 to 12 for engines with more than eight cylinders. Bentley built its last W12 in 2024 after describing a shut-off that idles one bank of six under part or trailing throttle, and the Lamborghini Aventador V12 shut one bank below 135 km/h; neither documents an exhaust actuator for cylinder 12. The clearest public account of exhaust valves following their own switching sequence remains a GM patent. Should the code appear, the module will disable deactivation. P3493 (open) and P3495 (low) complete the set, P3497 is the bank 2 system code.

causes.label: Exhaust actuator wire of cylinder 12 shorted to battery voltage
Shorted turns in the exhaust actuator coil
Engine control module output damaged

P3497.title: Cylinder Deactivation System Bank 2
P3497.description: The engine control module has detected a fault in the cylinder deactivation system on bank 2. Same as P3400 but for the second cylinder bank in V-engines.

causes.label: Deactivation solenoid or oil control valve failed
Collapsing lifter stuck
Low oil pressure prevents activation

P3498.title: Cylinder Deactivation Pressure Sensor Bank 1
P3498.description: The engine control module has detected a fault with the bank 1 cylinder deactivation pressure sensor. Newer variable displacement systems use an analogue oil pressure sensor in addition to or in place of the legacy switch; a fault disables closed-loop deactivation control on bank 1.

causes.label: Pressure sensor failed
Wiring or connector fault
Sensor port contaminated by sludge

P3499.title: Cylinder Deactivation Pressure Sensor Bank 2
P3499.description: The engine control module has detected a fault with the bank 2 cylinder deactivation pressure sensor. The analogue oil pressure sensor is used to verify the deactivation hydraulic state; a fault disables closed-loop deactivation control on bank 2.

causes.label: Pressure sensor failed
Wiring or connector fault
Sensor port contaminated by sludge
